target: capacitance retention percent at the specified horizon and conditions
evaluation: known development data, source-held out; unchanged 20 rows/15 papers in 2–6 M KOH P64 mild 3E scope. No external records used to choose neighbors or score this model. Only 12 10000-cycle rows/9 sources eligible for alternative; everyone else is scored unchanged.
donor_protocol: Same 10000-cycle primary scope, different paper; reported A/g ratio <=2, KOH molarity difference <=3; if both cell voltage widths known, difference <=0.2 V. Missing width flagged, not imputed.
distance: Grid cycles 500,1000,1500. Linear interpolation between verified early markers only, no extrapolation or synthetic training rows. Require >=2 common grid coordinates; all ordinates and last donor/query marker interval half widths (max side) <=2pp at used locations. Nominal shape match = RMS absolute difference in % at shared grid <=2pp. Distance = sqrt(shape_rms^2 + log2(Jd/Jq)^2 + ((Md-Mq)/3)^2).
neighbors: One closest curve per other source (stable row_id tiebreak), closest 3 sources; require >=2. Transfer donor terminal minus donor value at last shared coordinate to query value there. Inverse (1 + distance) weight; otherwise use unchanged P67 frozen prediction. No intercept, blend sweep or tunable k.
measurements: Upper x bound <=2000; compare lower/upper y envelopes; record pairwise common-grid values, actual-marker intervals, shared overlap, and registered endpoint differences for retrospective diagnosis only. Interpolated uncertainty descriptive, not statistical.
retention_rule: Retain for further blind testing only if overall and 10000-cycle source-balanced MAE and RMSE strictly lower and R² strictly higher, overall source and absolute p90 errors and maximum absolute error do not rise, all rows predicted positive, changed predictions span at least two papers. Otherwise reject immediately; do not alter rollback state or test new variants after unblinding. Even development success is not deployment.
sensitivity: Paired source bootstrap 10000 replicates seed 20261118 on MAE difference; fixed nearest matches with overlapping early reading envelopes are evidence for ambiguity, not causal proof.
short_horizon: Reconcile the locked 1000-cycle comparison already done; no training, rerouting or use of GKN8 to adjust weights. No new blind sample.
checkpoint: P64/P67, current pointer files and both P75/P77 locked evidence unchanged; no canonical database writes.
